pie: wiHrós dʰǵʰémi ḱéyor. nu h₁ésyo bʰréh₂tēr gʷegʷóme sédt-kʷe. nu h₂éǵt. bʰréh₂ter méroh₂ nu méne ḱléwos gʷíh₃wēti. méne gʷéru sléh₂gʷtu mē-kʷe HréwdHt. nu supnós h₁ím lémbʰt ḱlutós-kʷe bʰúHt.
english: The wounded hero lay on the earth. His brother came and sat beside him. The hero said, "Brother, I shall die, but my fame will live. Take my spear and do not cry out." Then sleep took him, and he became famous.

pie: h₂nḗr h₂usési gʷm̥yét. nu pótnih₂ h₁ím widét wérh₁yet-kʷe. wíHre gʷegʷómth₂e. kúdʰe h₁és? nu tébʰye déh₃ōr ḱléwos-kʷe bʰéroh₂. pótni sédtu h₁ḗdtu-kʷe. nu méwdt sísdont-kʷe.
english: The man came at dawn. His wife saw him and said, "Husband, you have come! Where were you?" "I bring you gifts and fame. Sit down, wife, and eat." Then she became glad, and they sat down.

pie: bʰréh₂terh₁e sédyetām píph₃et-kʷe. nu ḱós sékʷt. h₁eǵóh₂ pr̥h₂wós h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe stuh₂rós. ǵʰoysóm lémbʰoh₂. nu túH pr̥h₂wós nu wĺ̥kʷom moréyom. stnéh₂tu téwe-kʷe ǵʰoysóm h₁éptu. nu méh₂tēr h₁ludʰét mléwHt-kʷe. téwe bʰréh₂term̥ mē stunédt. h₂éǵros ne h₁wr̥Hús? nu h₁íh₂m̥ ḱléwsont ǵʰoysóns-kʷe dʰh₁ént.
english: Two brothers were sitting and drinking. This one said, "I am the first and I am strong. I shall take the spear." "You are the first, but I killed the wolf. Stand, and take your spear." The mother came and said, "Do not strike your brother! Is the field not broad?" They heard her and put down the spears.

pie: tréyes h₂néres móri gʷmént. nu h₁íd h₁wr̥Hú h₁regʷesyét-kʷe. nu pr̥h₂wós h₂éǵt. ḱéywōs mē tr̥mté. móri upér h₁éyomes ḱléwesōm-kʷe h₂isḱṓmes. nu litént. nu h₁íd h₁íns gʷr̥h₃ét nu h₁éysōm ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom.
english: Three men came to the sea. It was broad, and it was getting dark. Then the first said, "Dear ones, do not tremble. We shall go over the sea and seek fame." They went away. It swallowed them, but their fame is imperishable.

pie: pótnih₂ h₁ésmey wérh₁t. linékʷtu. péh₂wr̥ h₂léksōh₂ ǵr̥h₂nóm-kʷe h₂wékseti. h₁mé memóntu. téwe gʷéru ḱuh₁róm h₁syéh₁t téwe-kʷe h₁éḱwōs HeHḱéwes h₁sih₁ént. h₁mé h₂ew gʷm̥yétu.
english: The wife answered him, "Go. I shall guard the fire, and the grain will grow. Remember me. May your spear be strong, and may your horses be swift. Come back to me."

pie: ph₂tḗr suHnówey wérh₁t. méne wékʷesh₂ ḱléwsetu. téwe gʰostéyey mē dʰrugʰyét ǵʰoysṓd-kʷe mē bʰéwgt. h₁yód ḱód dʰédʰeh₁esi téwe ḱléwos méǵh₂ h₁éseti. nu h₁éytu deywṓs-kʷe twé ph₂sih₁ént. nu wékʷesh₂ h₂wéyst léytt-kʷe.
english: The father said to his son, "Hear my words. Do not lie to your guest, and do not flee from the spear. If you do this, your fame will be great. Now go, and may the gods protect you." He heard the words and went away.

pie: márkos stestóh₂e. nu kʷis h₁ím ne dʰégʷʰh₂t. nu wiHrós h₁ért h₁éḱwom-kʷe spéḱyet sékʷt-kʷe. twé yéwgoh₂. h₁mé wéǵʰēsi tébʰye-kʷe wódr̥ déh₃woh₂. nu h₁éḱwos stéh₂t h₁ím-kʷe wédʰet. nu pró gʷh₂ént h₁éḱwos-kʷe ḱlutós bʰúHt.
english: A wild horse was standing. No one had come near it. A hero came, looked at the horse, and said, "I shall yoke you. You will carry me, and I will give you water." The horse stood up and the hero led it away. Then they went forth, and the horse became famous.

pie: h₃rḗǵs wiHrṓy dóh₃r̥ déh₃t. nu tébʰye wĺ̥kʷosyo ḱérh₂sonm̥ bʰérōh₂. nu nókʷtm̥ h₁nédʰt. nu wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím ḱléwt h₁ím-kʷe próti drémt. nu wĺ̥kʷom lémbʰt h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱérh₂sonm̥ skélHt. nu ḱérh₂sonm̥ h₃réǵm̥ bʰoréyet. nu wérh₁yet. téwe h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm.
english: The king gave the hero a gift. "I will bring you the head of the wolf." Then he went out into the night. The wolf heard him and ran against him. But he seized the wolf and split its head. He carried the head to the king. He said, "Your name is famous."

pie: h₂éwsōs léwkt swóm-kʷe ǵʰoysóm kapyónts wiHrós márkons déwkt. nu h₁ésyo ḱéywōs stesth₂ḗr skʷént-kʷe. sh₂wéns kʷékʷlos pró gʷh₂yéh₁t. méǵh₂ ḱléwos wn̥yéh₁s. nu nos ḱóymom h₂léksete. nu márkōs pró dréms sth₂éh₁yont-kʷe.
english: Dawn became bright, and the hero, grasping his spear, drew the horses. His dear ones stood and said, "May the wheel of the sun go before you. May you win great fame." "Guard our home." Then the horses ran forward, and they stood there.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: wiHrós swóns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵrom déwkt h₁éymos-kʷe wérh₁yet. HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs h₁yóy polh₁úm h₁mé nékʷtsu bʰérete nu légʰyete. ǵr̥h₂nóm h₁édte wódr̥-kʷe píph₃ete. usmé kʷis ne yéwgeti. nu h₁éḱwōs h₁ím spéḱyont linékʷt-kʷe.
english: The hero led his horses to the field and spoke to them, "Swift horses, you who carried me for many nights, now lie down. Eat the grain, and drink the water. No one shall yoke you." The horses looked at him, and he went away.

pie: h₃rḗǵs wiHrṓy wérh₁yet. méǵʰye téwe márkons gʷṓs-kʷe déh₃tu h₁íns-wē sléh₂gʷoh₂ téwe-kʷe wóyḱom h₁éwsōh₂. nu ḱl̥néwt wéwket-kʷe. tébʰye méne h₁éḱwons mē déh₃woh₂ méne-kʷe gʷówes twé ne yéh₂onti. h₁yód h₁mé próti gʷm̥sḱḗsi méne gʷéru widḗsi. nu h₃rḗǵs gʷm̥yét nu h₁éy gʷéru kʷéḱt bʰéwgt-kʷe.
english: The king spoke to the hero, "Give me your horses and cattle, or I shall take them and burn your settlement." He heard and answered, "I will not give you my horses, and my cattle will not go to you. If you come against me, you will see my spear." The king came, but he saw the spear and fled.

pie: h₂éwsōs léwkt sh₂wéns-kʷe kʷékʷlos dʰǵʰémi mélh₃t. nu wiHrós stéh₂t h₁éḱwons-kʷe yugóm yéwgt wéwket-kʷe. HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs h₁mé bʰérete. nu h₁éḱwōs h₁ím h₂wisént pró-kʷe drémt.
english: Dawn became bright, and the wheel of the sun rose over the earth. The hero rose and yoked the horses to the yoke, and he said, "Swift horses, carry me!" The horses heard him and ran forward.

pie: wiHrós yéh₂t diwéy-kʷe ph₂tréy dʰǵʰméy-kʷe méh₂trey bʰéh₂t. déywōs h₁mé h₂wisté. usméy méne suHnúm dédeh₃mi. h₁ím ḱóymoy ph₂sté. h₁yód méroh₂ h₁éy méne h₁nómn̥ ḱléwsoyh₁t wérh₁yoyh₁t-kʷe. méne ḱléwos h₁wésu.
english: The hero went out and spoke to Father Sky and Mother Earth, "Hear me, you gods! I give you my son. Guard him in the home. If I die, let him hear my name, and let him say, 'My fame is good.'"

pie: h₂nḗr h₁ésyo ḱóymom linékʷt. nu sédt HréwdHt-kʷe. méne dʰwór. méne ph₂wénh₁. méne h₂éǵre. léytm̥ h₂ew-kʷe mē h₁ludʰṓh₂. deywṓs twé h₂léksoyh₁ent twé-kʷe kʷis mē h₁éwsoyh₁t.
english: The man left his home. He sat down and cried out, "My door! My fire! My field! I go away, and I shall not come back. May the gods guard you, and may no one burn you."

pie: swésōr h₁r̥sḱét mléwHt-kʷe. bʰréh₂ter kúdʰe yéh₂si? nu wéwket. swésor móri upér h₁éymi. nu wódr̥ péh₃tu ḱód-kʷe dóh₃r̥ h₁áyso. téwe swésorm̥ memóntu. dyḗws téwe h₂óǵmom h₂léksoyh₁t h₁usúh₁-kʷe ḱléwesh₁ h₂ew h₁r̥sḱétu. nu wódr̥ péh₃t dóh₃r̥ h₁áyto léytt-kʷe.
english: The sister came and said, "Brother, where are you going?" He answered, "Sister, I am going over the sea." "Drink the water, and take this gift. Remember your sister. May Sky guard your path, and come back with good fame." He drank the water, took the gift, and went.

pie: suHnús wiHrṓy ǵn̥h₁yéto. nu h₁ím déwsbʰis sléh₂gʷt bʰéh₂t-kʷe. tébʰye h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁oh₂. téwe h₁nómn̥ méǵh₂ h₁syéh₁t téwe-kʷe ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰiteh₂i h₁syéh₁t. déywōs h₁ím péh₂stu. nu deywṓs h₁ím ḱléwsont.
english: A son was born to the hero. He took him in his arms and said, "I shall give you a name." "May your name be great, and may your fame be imperishable. Gods, protect him." Then the gods heard him.

pie: wiHróh₁ ph₂wéni nékʷti sédyetām. nu ḱós h₁énosmey mléwHt. gʷéruh₂ h₂usési péh₃eti. h₁yód méroh₂ méne méh₂trey sékʷtu. ne bʰéwgt. nu h₁énos wéwket. h₁ésyeh₂ey h₂éǵoh₂. túH ḱlutós. nu píph₃etām légʰyetām-kʷe.
english: Two warriors were sitting by the fire in the night. This one said to that one, "At dawn the spears will drink. If I die, tell my mother, 'He did not flee.'" That one answered, "I shall tell her. You are famous." They drank, and they lay down.

pie: polh₁éwes wóyḱom nékʷti h₁ludʰónt. nu ḱós dʰwórm̥ Hrunépt h₁énos-kʷe péh₂wr̥ h₁ím dʰéh₁t. nu h₁íd dʰégʷʰet. nu h₃rḗǵs dʰwóri stéh₂t sékʷt-kʷe. ph₂wéns ne dedwóyh₂e h₁éymos-kʷe mē bʰéwgoh₂. nu h₁éysōm pr̥h₂wóm moréyet h₁éterōs-kʷe bʰugént.
english: Many came to the settlement at night. This one broke the door, and that one put fire into it. It burned. The king stood in the door and said, "I am not afraid of fire, and I will not flee from them." Then he killed the first of them, and the others fled.

pie: awis akwāsas ka.
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: stuh₂rós wiHrós wóyḱosyo dʰwóri stestóh₂e. nu HréwdHt. h₁yós ḱā́m dʰwórm̥ gʷm̥sḱḗti méne gʷéru widḗti. nu h₁suḱléwēs wiHrós gʷémt. nu mléwHt. dʰurés léyttu h₁íh₂m̥-wē Hrunépoh₂. nu stuh₂rós ne sth₂éh₁yet. nu swóm ǵʰoysóm Hyéh₁kt stuh₂rós-kʷe séngʷt. nu h₁íh₂m̥ Hrunépt wóyḱom-kʷe wéyḱt.
english: A strong hero stood at the door of the settlement. He cried out, "Whoever comes to this door will see my spear." Then the hero of good fame came. He said, "Stand aside from the door, or I shall break it." The strong one did not move. He hurled his spear, and the strong one fell. Then he broke it and went into the settlement.

pie: h₃rḗḱs súHnum wl̥nh₁to.
english: The king wanted a son.

pie: dʰh₂bʰróm kʷis gʷm̥yét. nu wéwket. méǵʰye gʷéru tḗtḱtu. nu dʰh₂bʰrós wr̥ǵyét. nu ǵʰoysóm gʷʰr̥néwt h₁ím-kʷe stunédt. nu h₁éy piḱtós h₁éy-kʷe ḱuh₁rós. nu h₁ím sléh₂gʷtu. méǵʰye dóh₃r̥ mē dédeh₃t. téwe ḱléwos méne misdʰós. nu ǵʰoysóm h₁áyto gʷéh₂t-kʷe.
english: Someone came to the smith. He said, "Make me a spear." The smith worked. He heated the spear and struck it. It was adorned and strong. "Take it. Do not give me a gift. Your fame will be my reward." He took the spear and went away.

pie: polh₁éwes h₂néres h₂éǵroy stn̥h₂ént. nu ḱós pró gʷémt HréwdHt-kʷe. kʷís h₁mé próti gʷémeti? méne gʷéru polh₁úns h₂nérn̥s moréyet. ne kʷosmōd dedwóyh₂e. nu téwe wékʷesh₂ polh₁úh₂ nu méne gʷéru péh₃eti. nu h₁ím próti h₁r̥sḱét ḱós-kʷe séngʷt.
english: Many men stood on the field. This one stepped out in front and cried, "Who will come against me? My spear killed men. I fear no one." "Your words are many, but my spear will drink." He came against him, and this one fell.

pie: stesth₂wé. nu ḱós h₁énosmey mléwHt. méne gʷṓs stéh₂yes. nu ne stéh₂yom. nu bʰoydʰéh₂m diwéh₁ dʰéh₁tu. nu h₁énos bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰéh₁t wérh₁t-kʷe. h₁yód dʰrugʰyṓh₂ dyḗws h₁mé moréyoyh₁t. nu dʰrugʰyét. nu dyḗws h₂wéyst mért-kʷe.
english: Two stood there. This one said to that one, "You stole my cattle." "I did not steal." "Then swear the oath by Sky." That one swore the oath and said, "If I lie, may Sky kill me." But he was lying. Sky heard, and he died.

pie: h₃rḗǵs légʰt suHnéwes-kʷe h₁ím h₁ludʰónt. nu bʰéh₂t. súHnewes méne gʷéruh₂ márkons-kʷe linékʷmi. bʰréh₂teres h₁sté bʰoydʰéh₂m-kʷe mē Hrumpté. h₁mé memn̥té. supnós h₁mé gʷm̥sḱéti.
english: The king lay down, and his sons came to him. He said, "Sons, I leave you my spears and my horses. Be brothers, and do not break the oath. Remember me. Sleep is coming to me."

pie: h₁r̥tā́m. nu kʷís túH? twé ne ǵn̥néh₃mi. nu h₁énos wérh₁t. téwe ph₂tḗr méne ph₂trés ḱóymoy gʰóstis h₁ést. nu ḱós wérh₁t. nu túH méne gʰóstis twé-kʷe mē moréyōh₂. téwe ǵʰoysóm dʰéh₁tu déh₃ōr-kʷe déh₃omes. méne h₁éḱwons sléh₂gʷtu téwe-kʷe ǵʰoysóm lémbʰoh₂. nu déh₃ōr h₁opéyetām ḱlutóh₁-kʷe bʰuHtā́m.
english: Two came. "Who are you? I do not know you." That one answered, "Your father was a guest in my father's home." This one said, "Then you are my guest, and I will not kill you. Put down your spear, and let us give gifts. Take my horses, and I shall take your spear." So they gave gifts, and they became famous.

pie: ḱós h₁ésyo gʰostéyey bʰéh₂t. h₂usési h₂éǵroy stnéh₂oh₂. téwe gʷrúh₁ gʷémtu. nu h₁ludʰṓh₂. sóh₂wl̥ n̥smé widóyh₁t. nu h₂éwsōs h₂wést stesth₂ḗr-kʷe. nu swéh₂ gʷéruh₂ Hih₁ktā́m h₁énos-kʷe séngʷt.
english: This one said to his enemy, "At dawn I shall stand on the field. Come with your spear." "I shall come. May the sun see us." Dawn became bright, and the two stood on the field. They hurled their spears, and that one sank down.
